column2: S-frames (Anchor B): rows within the 0.30-digit report band

column2: S-frames (Anchor A): mean local-minus-API difference in digits. No directional bias: the pod scatters by family rather than reading high or low

column2: S-frames (Anchor A): the signs of those differences, so 'no directional bias' is a count and not an adjective

column2: S-frames (Anchor A): the one family outside the band, and by how much
column4: SELECT row_key || ' ' || ROUND(delta_digits, 4) FROM anchor_calibration WHERE anchor='A' AND within_band=0

column4: SELECT ROUND(MAX(ABS(delta_digits)), 4) FROM anchor_calibration
